prompt:
Original cosy autumn colouring-book line art in clean black ink on white paper; bold rounded outer contours, smooth subtly hand-drawn linework, medium-weight interior details, broad colourable enclosed shapes, friendly softly stylised cartoon expressions, sparse natural and handmade texture marks, no filled shading, calm storybook warmth and home-printer-friendly clarity.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Cosy seasonal colouring-book line art with original storybook charm, using playful rounded forms and inviting domestic-scale detail.; line weight: Bold black outer contours with medium-weight interior detail lines; maintain generous enclosed colouring areas.; line quality: Smooth, gently imperfect hand-inked curves with softened corners and clear, steady joins.; detail level: Medium detail: clear focal silhouettes supported by selectively simplified decorative texture; avoid tiny marks and overly intricate repeats.; character language: Friendly, softly stylised cartoon characters with rounded proportions, simple expressive faces, and readable clothing or feature shapes.; background density: Moderately full scenic backgrounds built in shallow layers, with enough open space inside forms for relaxed colouring.; composition: Use one immediately readable focal area per page, balanced supporting details, varied page rhythms, and clear visual separation between overlapping forms.; palette: Monochrome black ink on white paper; designs should suggest a warm autumn atmosphere through motif and linework rather than filled colour.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No solid shading or grey fills; use sparse contour accents, simple texture lines, and occasional small pattern details only.; texture: Light hand-drawn texture through wood grain, leaf veins, fabric seams, masonry marks, and natural surface accents, always kept broad and colourable.; mood: Warm, peaceful, whimsical and gently festive, with an unhurried cosy feel..

PAGE 6 of "The Apple Pie Kitchen Colouring Book" (colouring): Text-free interior colouring page: baking counter viewed slightly from above, dominated by a rectangular tray holding exactly five large spiral cinnamon buns; the hedgehog baker’s paws gently place the fifth bun on the tray; include a rolling pin, one small bowl of icing and exactly two loose dough spirals beside the tray, with simple large kitchen tiles behind.

PAGE DETAIL: A top-forward counter composition shows a rectangular baking tray with five large spiral cinnamon buns. The hedgehog’s paws place the final bun on the tray. A rolling pin, a small bowl of icing and two loose dough spirals sit nearby, with a simple tiled splashback behind. Notes: Verify tray count: exactly five buns. The two loose dough spirals must be clearly distinct from the buns. Use broad spiral lines with open colouring spaces.

BOOK CONSISTENCY: This is page 6 of 10 in one colouring book whose style the owner approved from pages 2, 3, 10. Draw it in exactly that approved style: the same line weight and line quality, the same level of detail and colouring difficulty, the same visual density, border treatment and page margins, the same black-and-white treatment and the same character designs where characters appear. Do not restyle this page.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Portrait black-and-white colouring pages with generous clear margins and broad, easy-to-colour kitchen and autumn motifs. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any wording, typography, byline, badge device, character design, asset, or scene arrangement from the supplied references; Inflated outlined title lettering or circular lower-corner count callouts resembling the references; Photorealism, painterly colour fills, grey wash, heavy black backgrounds, or ink-heavy solid areas; Overcrowded pages, micro-details, tangled overlaps, or narrow uncolourable gaps; Frightening imagery, harsh horror styling, or menacing facial expressions; Misspelled text, illegible lettering, logos, trademarks, or artist signatures.
